title: Custom API: Run Complex FetchXML Queries from Canvas App
summary: Learn how to run complex FetchXML queries directly from a Canvas App using a Dataverse POST Custom API. This tutorial shows you how to bypass Power Automate Flows, build a signed plugin DLL, register a POST Custom API, and parse the results into JSON for dynamic use in your Canvas Apps. Ideal for advanced Power Platform developers who want more efficient, flexible, and secure ways to retrieve aggregated data across multiple tables.

title: Liquid vs Web API in Power Pages: Data Loading Performance
summary: In this post, I compare the performance of Liquid and Web API in Power Pages when rendering large datasets. Based on real-world tests with 200, 2,000, and 10,000 records, I analyze which approach delivers faster page loads, better scalability, and a smoother user experience. You’ll also learn best practices for data filtering, server-side calls, and asynchronous loading to avoid common performance pitfalls.
